newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: National Bank of NZ profit sharply down.
newsitem.headline: National Bank of NZ profit sharply down.

text.p: The National Bank of New Zealand on Saturday reported a sharp fall in pre-tax profit to NZ$130 million for the year ending December 31, 1996, from $201 million in 1995, the New Zealand Press Association reported.
After-tax profit was also down, at $97 million compared with $158 million a year earlier.
Commenting on the result, National Bank chairman Malcolm McCaw said the bank experienced excellent growth in all market segments in 1996.
However, volatility in both retail and wholesale rates in the first six months "significantly reduced interest margins and income from securities trading", the bank said in a statement.
The second six months of the year, particularly the last quarter, showed evidence of a recovery to satisfactory profit levels and a positive outlook for 1997, it said.
